Package com.charitymap.geometry

Class GeometryUtils

java.lang.Object
com.charitymap.geometry.GeometryUtils
public final class GeometryUtils extends Object
A small toolbox of pure geometric computations.

Every method here is static and has no side effect: it takes points as input and returns a result. This makes the class easy to test on the command line and easy to defend during the oral examination.

Author:
CharityMap team

  • Method Details

    • circumcenter

      public static Point circumcenter(Point a, Point b, Point c)
      Computes the circumcenter of the triangle defined by three points, that is to say the center of the unique circle passing through the three of them. In a Delaunay / Voronoi setting this circumcenter is exactly a Voronoi vertex.
      Parameters:
      a - the first vertex
      b - the second vertex
      c - the third vertex
      Returns:
      the circumcenter, or null when the three points are aligned

    • polygonArea

      public static double polygonArea(List<Point> vertices)
      Computes the area of a simple polygon using the shoelace formula. The vertices must be ordered (clockwise or counter clockwise).
      Parameters:
      vertices - the ordered vertices of the polygon
      Returns:
      the area, always returned as a positive value

    • centroid

      public static Point centroid(List<Point> points)
      Computes the centroid (average position) of a list of points.
      Parameters:
      points - the points (must not be null nor empty)
      Returns:
      the centroid

    • angleFromCenter

      public static double angleFromCenter(Point center, Point p)
      Returns the polar angle of a point as seen from a reference center. Used to sort the corners of a Voronoi cell so that the polygon does not self intersect.
      Parameters:
      center - the reference center
      p - the point whose angle is wanted
      Returns:
      the angle in radians, between -PI and PI
